A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same retrieval-bias study. Their full text, equations, tables, figures, and appendices support reliable comparison, including matching relocated and renumbered material.

before.justification: v1 reports original retrieval evaluations, controlled bias and adversarial-document experiments, and GPT-4o RAG results in Tables 2–5 and the appendix.

after.justification: v2 retains these empirical results and adds evaluations of ColBERT v2 and ReasonIR-8B, including their foil-document results in Table 4.

M1.justification: The Re-DocRED query-generation framework, controlled document constructions, DecompX analysis, and foil/poison procedures are retained. The additional retrievers are evaluation subjects; expanded captions and notation do not establish a changed proposed method.

E1.justification: Both versions use Natural Questions and Re-DocRED-derived retrieval, bias, foil, poison, and RAG scenarios. The added models use existing scenarios, and the newly listed query templates document existing dataset construction rather than establish expanded task coverage.

E2.justification: Table 4 adds ColBERT v2 and ReasonIR-8B alongside the original six retrievers. ColBERT v2 also enters the five-aspect comparison in Figure 1. This is a limited extension of the evaluated comparison methods.

E3.justification: The 250-query paired design, document manipulations, dataset settings, and retrieval and RAG metrics remain unchanged. Table 4's expanded caption makes the existing accuracy calculation explicit without establishing a revised evaluation protocol.

E4.justification: The combined-bias robustness test is extended to ColBERT v2 and ReasonIR-8B, examining whether failure persists for these additional retrieval approaches (Appendix A.1). ColBERT also receives an individual-bias profile. Existing position, length/repetition, error, and DecompX case analyses are retained.

E5.justification: v2 adds an explicit significance-reference footnote for Figure 1: p < .05 corresponds to |t| ≥ 1.97 with 249 degrees of freedom. Paired t-tests, reported p-values, and existing confidence intervals are retained; no additional runs or seeds are reported.

E6.justification: Table 4 adds ColBERT v2 at 7.6% accuracy with t = -20.96 and ReasonIR-8B at 8.0% with t = -36.92, both p < .01. Figure 1 adds ColBERT's bias results. The original six models' foil scores, other retained results, and Table 5's RAG accuracies are unchanged.

T1.justification: The document-construction equations and statistical calculation retain their mathematical substance. Changes such as R(D) to M(Q,D) clarify notation; the explicit accuracy description restates an existing metric. No new theorem, proof, assumption, or substantive derivation appears.

C1.justification: The abstract and introduction revise the combined-bias claim from selecting evidence in less than 3% of cases to less than 10%, accommodating the added models. The central claims about retrieval biases, compounded failure, and downstream RAG harm remain intact.

C2.justification: New Appendix A.1 discusses single-embedding efficiency versus ColBERT's token-level computation and storage costs, and interprets the added models' foil failures as persisting despite higher computational cost. Existing dataset-quality and LLM-evaluation limitations are unchanged.

D1.justification: New Table A.5 lists relation IDs and query templates, and Table A.2 adds checkpoint identifiers for ColBERT v2 and ReasonIR-8B. These improve documentation of dataset construction and evaluated models. The code/data link and existing RAG prompts are retained.

R1.justification: v2 adds Shao et al. (2025) on ReasonIR and discusses the study's relationship to more computationally expensive retrievers in Appendix A.1. Section 2 and the main novelty positioning remain stable; shortened bibliographic author lists do not remove cited works.

P1.justification: v2 makes targeted abstract and prose edits, expands explanatory captions, clarifies notation, and adds acknowledgements and a short 'More Models' appendix subsection. The main narrative and section sequence remain largely intact.

P2.justification: Figure 1 is redrawn with ColBERT replacing the displayed RetroMAE curve. Table 4 gains rows and an expanded caption; new appendix tables provide query templates and redisplay the foil comparison. Existing appendix figures and tables are rearranged, while their retained graphical content is unchanged.

improvement.justification: Compared with v1's six-model foil evaluation, v2 tests ColBERT v2 and ReasonIR-8B, strengthening evidence that the failure extends to additional retrieval approaches. Query templates, checkpoint identifiers, and clearer captions improve reproducibility and understanding. These are useful but bounded gains: dataset coverage, the underlying framework, RAG evidence, and principal limitations remain unchanged.
